text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Karlsruhe stood at 13.53 €/m², up 4.8 % year‑on‑year and 26.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 13th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² typical apartment costs about 812 € per month, with a rent‑burden of 17.1 % for two residents, while the asking premium over existing rents is 60 %.

The market remains balanced: vacancy is low at 1.5 %, listings stay on the market for roughly 22 days and 30 % are let within a week, indicating tight supply despite a modest –1.0 % population decline over five years.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 13.99 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.55 €/m² and 14.4 €/m², implying a further 3.4 % rise.
